SELECT fished_date_season AS season, fished_date_doy AS doy, cls, landing, boat,
       yt, anglers, ROUND(yt*1.0/anglers,2) AS yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('overnight','day_1_5','three_quarter')
  AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 88 AND 108
ORDER BY fished_date_season, fished_date_doy, cls
SELECT * FROM climate WHERE index_id='oni' ORDER BY avail_season, avail_doy DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, cls, landing, boat
FROM schedule
WHERE cls IN ('overnight','day_1_5') AND fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 91 AND 105
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls, boat

SELECT value, avail_t, avail_season, avail_doy
FROM climate
WHERE index_id='oni'
ORDER BY avail_t DESC
LIMIT 8

SELECT report_date_season, report_date_doy, yt_all, yt_local, text
FROM fishdope
ORDER BY report_date_season DESC, report_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 6
